label: sec:piand
title: Parametric Integer And
html:
The term &N(k,x,y) denotes the parametric integer and of x and y viewed as bit-vectors of width k. Its sub-solver follows the same scheme as the exp-solver.

Table 7 lists the new lemmas of the &N-solver. They extend the lemmas of [7, Table 4], which we keep and do not repeat here.
